page.unknown_echoes.0.title: Page ??? · Unnamed Record
page.unknown_echoes.0.text: The writing has long faded. Only one line remains: ...go and listen.
page.unknown_echoes.1.title: Page 001 · First Echo Heard
page.unknown_echoes.1.text: On the first night, the lines beneath the stone trembled together. We pressed our ears to them and heard that day's footsteps.
page.unknown_echoes.2.title: Page 002 · The Birds Depart
page.unknown_echoes.2.text: The day the sound stopped, every bird flew north. By the third day, none had returned, and the gatekeeper had forgotten who first closed the city gate.
page.unknown_echoes.17.title: Page 017 · Beacon in the Mountain
page.unknown_echoes.17.text: We did not build the first beacon. It grew in the mountain like a bone from the world's inner ear; it took us seven months to dig it awake.
page.unknown_echoes.23.title: Page 023 · Listeners in Stone
page.unknown_echoes.23.text: No furnace burns inside the Colossus, only layers of stone tablets carved with sequences. It keeps the wind's way of listening and waits for someone who can make the pillars speak again.
page.unknown_echoes.42.title: Page 042 · The Lake Does Not Lie
page.unknown_echoes.42.text: Do not trust your reflection. The lake keeps more of the past than the shore does.
page.unknown_echoes.56.title: Page 056 · Silencing the Earth
page.unknown_echoes.56.text: Stone refused to fall silent, so they dismantled everything that could answer. In the end, no one in the city spoke either.
page.unknown_echoes.89.title: Page 089 · Five Ways of Hearing
page.unknown_echoes.89.text: When the five ways of listening met at the altar, the sky did not split. The ground moved first, and a breath that belonged to no one came from the sixth seat.
page.unknown_echoes.104.title: Page 104 · Final Record
page.unknown_echoes.104.text: When the five ways sounded together at the altar, kept and erased records woke together. We had time only to place them with five custodians.

rune.unknown_echoes.tide.0: At high tide we sank the temple; at low tide the temple sank us.
rune.unknown_echoes.tide.1: Beneath the lake lies another surface. Do not trust the one you see first.
rune.unknown_echoes.tide.2: The Watcher keeps its eyes open in the depths. It has counted every ripple.
rune.unknown_echoes.tide.3: Wake every pillar. The tide will return your name.
page.unknown_echoes.43.title: Page 043 · Reversed Ripples
page.unknown_echoes.43.text: A stone fell into the lake, but the ripples drew inward. The old recorder put away the lens and said the lakebed was pulling something back.
page.unknown_echoes.44.title: Page 044 · Three Tidal Pillars
page.unknown_echoes.44.text: The temple was not drowned. Its steps sank into the lake one by one. Three tidal pillars still wait below for a hand willing to enter the black water.
page.unknown_echoes.45.title: Page 045 · The Watcher's Eye
page.unknown_echoes.45.text: The Abyss Watcher keeps the tidal way of listening while the black tide hides the lakebed records. Drive away its followers, then relight the underwater runes; only then will the seal in its chest loosen.

page.unknown_echoes.46.title: Page 046 · Hearing the True Mirror
page.unknown_echoes.46.text: A blindfolded traveler left the temple alive. He said the water deceives the eyes; the true mirror rings lower, and you must wait for it to ring in the dark.
page.unknown_echoes.47.title: Page 047 · Prisoner in the Mirror
page.unknown_echoes.47.text: The Mirror Guardian locks the erased way of listening inside the reflection and will not let the original shadow leave the archive. Find the true sigils and make them answer together; then the seal will loosen.

page.unknown_echoes.50.title: Page 050 · The Silent Order's Vow
page.unknown_echoes.50.text: They said we turned our backs on the echoes. We only put away the part the world could no longer bear. When the swamp accepted that vow, it took the speaker's voice as well.
page.unknown_echoes.51.title: Page 051 · The Swamp's Writing
page.unknown_echoes.51.text: The stone hut has no writing, yet its moss grows toward the same sealed door each year. The Silent Order left its last route for the eye; the ear can find nothing there.
"The archive sank into Mirror Lake. One eye waits below for light."
page.unknown_echoes.60.title: Page 060 · Archive in the Sky
page.unknown_echoes.60.text: The Chroniclers swore to record every echo, beacon, and name. When the ground could hold no more volumes, they added floor after floor to the archive.
page.unknown_echoes.61.title: Page 061 · The Weightless Archive
page.unknown_echoes.61.text: When the Great Forgetting arrived, the archive lost its weight first. Pages and broken bridges drifted into the wind, while the torn index kept repeating its last query.
page.unknown_echoes.62.title: Page 062 · Wind-Current Search
page.unknown_echoes.62.text: Wind serves as the archive's index. Follow it to volumes that have not fallen; walk against it to find the erased query.

advancement.unknown_echoes.root.title: Unknown Echoes: Main story
advancement.unknown_echoes.root.desc: Echo ruins lie buried in Overworld forests and plains. Loot a chest for your first Echo Shard.
Craft an Echo Realm Key from 4 Echo Shards and an Echo Core, then touch a Resonance Beacon in a forest or plain.
advancement.unknown_echoes.echo_key_craf: Echo Cores sit in Small Echo Ruin and Silent Ring chests. Add 4 shards to forge the key.
advancement.unknown_echoes.enter_echo_re: Once the beacon is lit, touch it again empty-handed to be carried into the Echo Realm.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_forgot: Challenge the colossus in the Echo Temple's Memory Pillar Courtyard. Watch the 4 pillars, then repeat their sequence to break its guard.
advancement.unknown_echoes.ability_wind_: After defeating the Forgotten Colossus, bring the Wind Resonance Token to the Wind Core Altar to claim the ability.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_abyss_: Challenge the Abyss Watcher in the Sunken Temple. Defeat or lure away its black-tide phantoms, then purify the marked underwater runes to break the veil.
advancement.unknown_echoes.ability_tide_: After defeating the Abyss Watcher, bring the Tide Resonance Token to the Tide Core Altar to claim the ability.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_mirror: Real and false sigils mix in the Mirror Temple. Fish circle the real ones. Light 4 of those.
advancement.unknown_echoes.ability_true_: After defeating the Mirror Guardian, bring the True Sight Resonance Token to the True Sight Core Altar to claim the ability.
advancement.unknown_echoes.grand_archive: The Grand Archive stands deep in the Echo Realm. Touch its archive terminal empty-handed to register.
advancement.unknown_echoes.archive_trial: The archive has wind, tide, and true sight wings. Open each with its echo; all three must belong to one terminal.
advancement.unknown_echoes.echo_realm_gr: Gain all three realm echoes, defeat the three realm bosses, and complete all three trials linked to one archive terminal to finish the realm archive.
advancement.unknown_echoes.echo_realm_co: Eight biomes, 48 pages, six guardians, completion score 150. Claim the Echo Realm Core at the terminal.
advancement.unknown_echoes.enter_deep_ec: After archiving, find an Abyss Beacon and calibrate it empty-handed with wind, tide, then true sight. Touch it again to enter.
advancement.unknown_echoes.fracture_hall: Three route nodes wait in the hall: wind, tide, true sight. Activate each with its echo.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_void_p: With all routes set, head to the Calibration Hall. Open its 3 nodes with the three echoes, then touch the Gravity Core altar.
advancement.unknown_echoes.ability_gravi: After defeating the Void Prophet, bring the Gravity Resonance Token to the Gravity Core Altar to claim the ability.
advancement.unknown_echoes.space_anchors: Activate 3 space anchors with Gravity Echo to open the void route.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_rift_w: Once the void route opens, activate the 3 stabilizers beside the Void Core Altar, then touch the altar.
advancement.unknown_echoes.ability_void_: After defeating the Rift Warden, bring the Void Resonance Token to the Void Core Altar to claim the ability.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_world_: With all five echoes in hand, summon it at the resonance altar in the World Resonance Hall.
advancement.unknown_echoes.world_echo_co: After defeating the World Echo, use the Ending Record Table with an empty hand. Leave room for 8 Last Record Fragments to complete the final record.
advancement.unknown_echoes.first_guardia: A guardian holds the centre of each regional ruin. Defeat any one of them.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_storm_: Top floor of the Sky Observatory in the Floating Isles. Wind Echo opens the way.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_tide_l: The lamp room of the Tide Lighthouse Reef. Tide Echo required.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_mirror: At the end of the Mirror Dust Cloister. True Sight Echo cuts through the illusions.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_silent: The Silent Altar in the Silent Swamp.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_crysta: Challenge the Songkeeper in the Crystal Song Hall. Tune the pillars in the order they light up, then attack while its resonance is broken.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_broken: The Broken Bridge Archive in the Broken Bell Wastes.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_dream_: The Dream Flower House in the Dreaming Meadow.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_lost_r: The inner court of the Echo Grand Archive.
advancement.unknown_echoes.guardians_6.d: Defeat 6 guardians. One of the conditions for realm mastery.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_invert: The Inverted Pendulum Palace. Gravity Echo steadies the arena.
advancement.unknown_echoes.defeat_ash_sc: The last record room on the east side of the Folded Celestial Archive.
advancement.unknown_echoes.first_ruin.de: Step into any echo ruin or world wonder. The journal records it for you.
advancement.unknown_echoes.explorer_5.de: Record 5 different types of ruins or wonders.
advancement.unknown_echoes.explorer_20.d: Record 20 different types of ruins or wonders. Each first discovery restores a little Echo Energy.
advancement.unknown_echoes.all_biomes.de: Visit all 10 Echo Realm biomes. Completion only asks for 8.
advancement.unknown_echoes.world_tree.de: The tallest tree in the Echo Forest, its crown breaking the cloud layer.
advancement.unknown_echoes.mirror_sea.de: Where Mirror Lake ends and the water goes perfectly still.
advancement.unknown_echoes.sky_rift.desc: The tear in the sky above the Floating Isles.
advancement.unknown_echoes.silent_ark.de: The great ship run aground in the Silent Swamp.
advancement.unknown_echoes.broken_bell_t: The tower on the Broken Bell Wastes whose bell has cracked.
advancement.unknown_echoes.eternal_light: A beam sweeps from beneath Mirror Lake. Follow it down.
advancement.unknown_echoes.inverted_moun: Mountain shadows hang above the Floating Isles without touching ground.
advancement.unknown_echoes.all_wonders.d: Record at least 5 of the 7 world wonders.
advancement.unknown_echoes.first_world_e: Echo anomalies rise on their own across the realm. Stand near any one and the journal records it.
advancement.unknown_echoes.world_events_: Witness 8 different echo anomalies. Some appear only in certain biomes.
Solve or inspect 10 sequence, ring, chime, matching-page or workshop mechanisms. Each type counts up to 8 sites.
advancement.unknown_echoes.all_deep_biom: Visit all 6 Deep Echoes biomes: Folded Corridors, Shattered Archive, Inverted Chasm, Weightless Grotto, Silent Abyss, Voidscar Hollows.
advancement.unknown_echoes.deep_micro_si: Visit all 6 Deep Echoes biomes and find the Folded Waystation, Gravity Shard Spire, and Hushed Refuge.
advancement.unknown_echoes.deep_monument: Visit all 6 Deep Echoes biomes and find all ten major ruins, including the Resonance Foundry, Voidscar Bastion, and Riftglass Citadel.
advancement.unknown_echoes.first_creatur: Approach any echo creature. The bestiary records it for you.
Record every creature in the bestiary, including Foldpage Bugs and Void Wanderers from Deep Echoes.

advancement.unknown_echoes.pages_48.desc: Read 48 Echo Realm pages to meet the page requirement for realm mastery.
advancement.unknown_echoes.all_pages.des: Read all 160 pages across both dimensions. The deep 80 require entering Deep Echoes.

advancement.unknown_echoes.blueprint_fou: The three blueprints can be found in chests at Wind Vaults, Sky Observatories, and Tide Lighthouse Reefs. Lost Travelers also sell them.
advancement.unknown_echoes.forge_wind_sp: Combine the blueprint with an Echo Weapon Frame, Wind Rune Shard, and Crystal Feather. The blueprint is not consumed.
advancement.unknown_echoes.forge_tide_cr: A crossbow plus blueprint, Echo Weapon Frame, Tide Pearl, and Echo String.
advancement.unknown_echoes.forge_true_si: With the blueprint ready, combine it with Echo Weapon Frame, Illusion Dust, and Mirror Lake Shard.

advancement.unknown_echoes.armor_wind_wa: Upgrade Echo Traveler armor with Windwoven Thread, Crystal Feather, Wind Rune Shard, Echo Armor Plate, and Wind Enhancement Core.
advancement.unknown_echoes.armor_tide_st: Upgrade Echo Traveler armor with Mirror-Tide Alloy Plate, Mirror Scale, Tide Pearl, Echo Armor Plate, and Tide Upgrade Core.
advancement.unknown_echoes.armor_true_si: Upgrade Echo Traveler armor with Illusion Prism, Polished Mirror Dust, Decoy Shard, Echo Armor Plate, and True Sight Upgrade Core.
advancement.unknown_echoes.armor_silent_: Upgrade Echo Traveler armor with Silent Resin, Moss Shell Plate, Muffle Moss, Echo Armor Plate, and Silence Upgrade Core.
advancement.unknown_echoes.all_regional_: Collect the Wind Walker, Tide Stalker, True Sight Shadow, and Silent Watch sets.

advancement.unknown_echoes.oath_armor.de: Upgrade any regional pieces with Oathbound Alloy: one each for helmet and boots, two each for chestplate and leggings.
advancement.unknown_echoes.oathblade.des: Combine a diamond sword with an Echo Weapon Frame, Echo Core, and 2 Oathbound Alloy.

page.unknown_echoes.3.title: Page 003 · Cold Light of the Beacon
page.unknown_echoes.3.text: Cold light crawls along the beacon's seams. Once the key fits the socket, wind answers from behind the stone before the door moves.
page.unknown_echoes.4.title: Page 004 · Echo of the Entrant
page.unknown_echoes.4.text: Two people pressed the beacon together, and two different marks rose in the stone. The keeper said it records what each person heard, not their name.
page.unknown_echoes.5.title: Page 005 · The First Small Ruin
page.unknown_echoes.5.text: Every wind-mark in the small ruin points to one valley. Four pillars stand at its center, with footsteps older than the mountain buried in their cracks.
page.unknown_echoes.6.title: Page 006 · The Lost Traveler's Map
page.unknown_echoes.6.text: The Lost Traveler's map has no roads, only blank spaces. Lay it on a ruin stone and the ink moves toward the next place that still answers.
page.unknown_echoes.7.title: Page 007 · Personal Mark
page.unknown_echoes.7.text: The altar leaves a different pattern in every listener's palm. A companion can open the door, but cannot carry away the echo that answers only you.
page.unknown_echoes.8.title: Page 008 · Realm Boundary
page.unknown_echoes.8.text: When I crossed the boundary, the beacon stayed behind while my shadow fell into the mist first. After I returned, stones on both sides held the same footprints.
page.unknown_echoes.18.title: Page 018 · The Colossus Remembers
page.unknown_echoes.18.text: We scraped the Colossus's name from the stone, but the four pillars kept their order. Whenever the wind rises, it listens to the erased memory again.
page.unknown_echoes.19.title: Page 019 · Windmark Order
page.unknown_echoes.19.text: The apprentices always reach for the pillars too soon, and the wind starts over. Wait through the full round, then answer in the original order. Only then will the pillars fall quiet.
page.unknown_echoes.20.title: Page 020 · Listening in Flow
page.unknown_echoes.20.text: Wind carries sound away but leaves its direction in the grass. A listener does not chase it; they stand where it will pass next.
page.unknown_echoes.21.title: Page 021 · Wind Doors Are Not Walls
page.unknown_echoes.21.text: A traveler flew over the wind door, but the mechanism beyond stayed silent. The stone accepts a hand that answered its marks, not someone standing higher.
page.unknown_echoes.22.title: Page 022 · Archive Above
page.unknown_echoes.22.text: The observatory is so high its steps vanish from sight. Old recorders rode the wind to reach it. The marks under its rail still glow, waiting for a late watchkeeper.
page.unknown_echoes.24.title: Page 024 · Storm Compass
page.unknown_echoes.24.text: The compass needle does not point north; it follows recorded echoes. The Storm Weaver took its listening needle, so now it can only circle nearby.
page.unknown_echoes.48.title: Page 048 · Tide Lantern Keeper
page.unknown_echoes.48.text: The Tide Lantern Keeper chases the brightest thing. Light the submerged buoy and hide behind it; the keeper will hit the old anchor chain first.
page.unknown_echoes.49.title: Page 049 · Lingering Lantern Heat
page.unknown_echoes.49.text: The wick remains warm after the keeper falls. Someone carried it to the Artifact Record Table, and the lantern revealed a waterway leading deeper into the lake.
page.unknown_echoes.57.title: Page 057 · Reflection Half a Beat Late
page.unknown_echoes.57.text: The false image always trails the body by half a beat. Ignore its face and watch the water at its feet; the first ripple belongs to the living record.
page.unknown_echoes.58.title: Page 058 · True Sigil
page.unknown_echoes.58.text: Fish never cross a true sigil; they circle its edge. A false mark may shine on the lake, but it cannot hold a single fish.
page.unknown_echoes.59.title: Page 059 · Decoy Habits
page.unknown_echoes.59.text: A decoy can copy the guardian's movements, but not the sound of mirror dust landing. After the switch, the one whose footprints still carry sparks is the original.
page.unknown_echoes.63.title: Page 063 · Hidden Inscription
page.unknown_echoes.63.text: The inscription has no missing letters. Its second layer hides in the first layer's reflection; once you see the water's surface clearly, strokes appear on the blank wall.
page.unknown_echoes.64.title: Page 064 · Unvarnished Memory
page.unknown_echoes.64.text: Stone lets the victor grind away the stains; water does not. A reflection keeps what happened the first time, not the version written afterward.
page.unknown_echoes.65.title: Page 065 · Mirror Dust Steward
page.unknown_echoes.65.text: The Mirror Dust Steward leaves a flash where it lands after swapping places.
page.unknown_echoes.70.title: Page 070 · The Swamp Swallows Sound
page.unknown_echoes.70.text: Black water swallows calls, and thick moss presses down footprints. A wrong turn sends its ripples back; follow the way the moss leans.
page.unknown_echoes.71.title: Page 071 · The Silent Order's Old Vow
page.unknown_echoes.71.text: The Silent Order never spoke its vow. Blade marks on the sealed vault say enough: some records must end here. Each name removed beyond the door left one less echo in the city.
page.unknown_echoes.72.title: Page 072 · Silent Ring
page.unknown_echoes.72.text: No sound reaches the ring's center, but the murals outside join one another. Follow the painted footsteps around the circle, and the silence will retreat.
page.unknown_echoes.73.title: Page 073 · Silent Priest
page.unknown_echoes.73.text: The priest guards the deepest silence with its fingers pressed to the carved vow. It lowers its lamp only when insects sing in the swamp again.
page.unknown_echoes.74.title: Page 074 · Mossback Shell
page.unknown_echoes.74.text: Mossback turtles leave old shells on dry stones. Armorers set the plates inside gear, where they keep swamp pressure from twisting the wearer's bones.
page.unknown_echoes.75.title: Page 075 · Price of the Great Forgetting
page.unknown_echoes.75.text: We severed the echoes between the two layers, and our own voices vanished first. On the night the seal held, no one could name the person beside them.
page.unknown_echoes.76.title: Page 076 · Silence Does Not Answer
page.unknown_echoes.76.text: We sealed silence inside the altar and waited for it to yield a new way of listening. It gave no answer; it erased the questioner from the roster.
page.unknown_echoes.77.title: Page 077 · Lantern in Silent Fog
page.unknown_echoes.77.text: When fog pressed down, one lamp without a flame remained in the swamp. Up close, the light came from a crystal grove far away, caught in black water.
page.unknown_echoes.80.title: Page 080 · Crystal Song Taxonomy
page.unknown_echoes.80.text: We number crystals by pitch, not color. The light changed three times, and the colors with it, but the scale inside the cracks stayed in place.
page.unknown_echoes.81.title: Page 081 · Tone Pillar Sequence
page.unknown_echoes.81.text: The chime pillars must be sounded in order. One apprentice struck the first before the song ended, and the door sang the whole sequence again.
page.unknown_echoes.82.title: Page 082 · Songkeeper
page.unknown_echoes.82.text: When the Songkeeper raises its staff, the first pillar lights. Tune the pillars in that order, and the resonance above its head will scatter.
page.unknown_echoes.83.title: Page 083 · Resonance Rod
page.unknown_echoes.83.text: A slim rod cut from tuned crystal carries a note across a broken bridge. Copyists used it to strike response pillars without climbing back across for every record.
page.unknown_echoes.84.title: Page 084 · Recorded Scale
page.unknown_echoes.84.text: Before sealing the vault, the Chroniclers sang that day's scale into a crystal cluster. Long after the pages scattered, the crystals still sang the order back.
page.unknown_echoes.85.title: Page 085 · Crystal Song Hall
page.unknown_echoes.85.text: After the great hall's final performance, the grove remembered one melody. The musicians stopped coming one by one, but the broken pillars still keep their time.
page.unknown_echoes.86.title: Page 086 · Whispers from a Sea of Flowers
page.unknown_echoes.86.text: Pollen keeps words left unfinished in dreams. When dawn wind crosses the field, the flowers return them in voices that still carry their speakers' accents.
page.unknown_echoes.87.title: Page 087 · Traveler in Dream Mist
page.unknown_echoes.87.text: The Lost Traveler never loses the path in dream mist, but cannot say where he went after waking. He hears every echo and cannot tell why they all call him back.
page.unknown_echoes.88.title: Page 088 · Dream Bloom Keeper
page.unknown_echoes.88.text: Nearby buds close the Bloom Keeper's wounds. Follow the light and draw near; the buds wither one by one, and its wounds stop healing.
page.unknown_echoes.90.title: Page 090 · Heard but Not Understood
page.unknown_echoes.90.text: The children still hear old voices inside stone, but no one taught them how to understand them. Their forebears left them ears that could hear, but no language to explain what they heard.
page.unknown_echoes.91.title: Page 091 · Unrecorded Places
page.unknown_echoes.91.text: Several blanks at the map's edge still have no numbers. No guardian waits there, only tools left during the hurried evacuation and paths no one walked twice.
page.unknown_echoes.92.title: Page 092 · The Unfinished Motion
page.unknown_echoes.92.text: The broken bell records an unfinished action. Each toll replays the last failure beneath it.
page.unknown_echoes.93.title: Page 093 · Cracklight Countdown
page.unknown_echoes.93.text: When the pendulum rises, its cracks light one by one. Strike the bell before the last light dies to stop the countdown.
page.unknown_echoes.94.title: Page 094 · Broken Bell Keeper
page.unknown_echoes.94.text: The Broken Bell Keeper's rusted armor cannot withstand the pendulum's vibration. When it raises the bell, every plate loosens with the swing, exposing the hollow inside.
page.unknown_echoes.95.title: Page 095 · Rust Gear
page.unknown_echoes.95.text: The rusted gears, each missing a tooth, hold steadier than new ones under strain. Tower smiths set them in heavy armor joints, saying old scars know best how to absorb a blow.
page.unknown_echoes.96.title: Page 096 · Before the Toll
page.unknown_echoes.96.text: Before the broken bell tolls, the pendulum makes several heavy beats. When the last falls, the scattered echo returns to its beginning.
page.unknown_echoes.97.title: Page 097 · No More Rewinding
page.unknown_echoes.97.text: We broke every bell, thinking the day would turn back. Echoes keep the past, but never promised to give it back.
page.unknown_echoes.105.title: Page 105 · Archive Gate
page.unknown_echoes.105.text: The archive gate has three panels: wind runes, a tide panel, and a third panel visible only in reflection.
page.unknown_echoes.106.title: Page 106 · The Three-Wing Gate
page.unknown_echoes.106.text: The wind panel reads direction, the tide panel remembers the depths, and the mirror panel recognizes erased traces. When all three answer the same person's mark, the next light appears.
page.unknown_echoes.107.title: Page 107 · The Wall of Missing Pages
page.unknown_echoes.107.text: The wall's empty slots correspond to scattered records, unfinished ruins, and custodians still at their posts. The final page will not appear until they are filled.
page.unknown_echoes.108.title: Page 108 · Lost Recorder
page.unknown_echoes.108.text: The chief recorder filed the final page in the index and stayed in the book. The blank will move once the scattered pages are returned.
page.unknown_echoes.109.title: Page 109 · Two Blank Spaces
page.unknown_echoes.109.text: The final page holds two spaces side by side: one to write, one to erase.
page.unknown_echoes.110.title: Page 110 · Memory Stratum
page.unknown_echoes.110.text: The Realm Core holds a layer of unclaimed memories. Dusk, mist, and floating stone settle from it, while an older fold lies beneath.
page.unknown_echoes.111.title: Page 111 · The Unfiled Index
page.unknown_echoes.111.text: The index holds one entry that was never filed: no title, only every record layered into one afterimage. Each time it opens, the records reorder themselves from the earliest page.
page.unknown_echoes.112.title: Page 112 · Deep Clue
page.unknown_echoes.112.text: Every downward echo turns back at the boundary except the Realm Core's. It points into the folded depths, where no road can hold a person's weight yet.
page.unknown_echoes.113.title: Page 113 · World Tree Silhouette
page.unknown_echoes.113.text: Before the rift closed, I saw a tree crossing three layers of sky. It had no leaves, but every branch carried the wind of a different season.
page.unknown_echoes.120.title: Page 120 · Echo Deer
page.unknown_echoes.120.text: When a wounded Echo Deer flees, it throws a trail of light toward a nearby ruin. A hunter lost the deer but followed the light to a stone door hidden in mist.
page.unknown_echoes.121.title: Page 121 · Glow Rabbit
page.unknown_echoes.121.text: Glow Rabbits dive into the grass at the first sign of a strange shadow, their flank marks blinking in the mist. When a whole cluster glows at the forest edge, no footsteps are nearby for the moment.
page.unknown_echoes.122.title: Page 122 · Crystalfeather Bird
page.unknown_echoes.122.text: Crystalfeather Birds molt into the wind, leaving feathers on high ledges. Their tips retain the updraft and help wind-aligned smiths tune a bowstring.
page.unknown_echoes.123.title: Page 123 · Mirror-tail Fish
page.unknown_echoes.123.text: A Mirror-tail Fish's silver tail sinks a beat after its body. Its flesh clears the dark lakebed for a moment, but you must still tell true from false.
page.unknown_echoes.124.title: Page 124 · Pearl Clam
page.unknown_echoes.124.text: Pearl Clams hide among Pearl Anemone roots, and their shells still carry a tidal sound. Divers once held them to their ears to find the way back.
page.unknown_echoes.125.title: Page 125 · Silent Walker
page.unknown_echoes.125.text: Silent Walkers follow vibration, not sound. Stop before entering thick moss, and they will follow the direction of your last step.
page.unknown_echoes.126.title: Page 126 · Broken Bell Crow
page.unknown_echoes.126.text: Broken Bell Crows carry rust flakes to the tower roof and hone their beaks on them. Their dark feathers collect metal dust that makes durable armor lining.
page.unknown_echoes.127.title: Page 127 · Archive Afterimage
page.unknown_echoes.127.text: An archive afterimage repeats only the final action in its record. Approach after it finishes, before the next memory catches up.

page.unknown_echoes.128.title: Page 128 · Folded Archive
page.unknown_echoes.128.text: Pages do not turn here; they fold the corridor into the next line of text. Remember the pale light along the spine. It still knows the entrance when you turn back.
page.unknown_echoes.129.title: Page 129 · Ruins in the Fold
page.unknown_echoes.129.text: The same crack opens onto the same wall, while the signs name different ages. The bricks bear makers' marks from the Listeners' old city, and each unfolding moves them to another street.
page.unknown_echoes.130.title: Page 130 · Inverted Bridge
page.unknown_echoes.130.text: The bridge did not turn over; the weight it carried changed direction first. Stay close to the span while the core shines, then cross the break after the light fades.
page.unknown_echoes.131.title: Page 131 · Boundary of Weight
page.unknown_echoes.131.text: A gravity core controls one room only. Step across the double-ring line and the floor immediately returns to its old direction.
page.unknown_echoes.132.title: Page 132 · Three Space Anchors
page.unknown_echoes.132.text: One pair of hands must steady all three anchors, and all three must belong to the same array. Mix in an anchor from elsewhere and the rift will not close; it swallows even more sound.
page.unknown_echoes.133.title: Page 133 · Calibration Cannot Be Shared
page.unknown_echoes.133.text: The hall's three measures belong to Wind, Tide, and True Sight. Companions may watch and answer together, but calibration marks cannot be recorded for another person.
page.unknown_echoes.134.title: Page 134 · Void Prophet
page.unknown_echoes.134.text: The Void Prophet guards the way of hearing the world's frame, protected by three misaligned wards. Find the skewed measure at the arena's edge, then use the matching echo to realign its ward.
page.unknown_echoes.135.title: Page 135 · Void Vein Chamber
page.unknown_echoes.135.text: The chamber's blankness eats away at your sense of direction. Stabilize all three rifts before the central altar accepts the room as part of the world.
page.unknown_echoes.136.title: Page 136 · Suppression Aftershock
page.unknown_echoes.136.text: The core presses living things to the floor, sending ripples through the stone. I waited for them to settle before reaching out again; only then did the core answer.
page.unknown_echoes.137.title: Page 137 · Overheated Rings
page.unknown_echoes.137.text: The surveyors added gravity rings one by one to hold the archive pages down. When the last ring lit, the whole room fell instead.
page.unknown_echoes.138.title: Page 138 · The Descent Command
page.unknown_echoes.138.text: Wings and lift are no exception to the Gravity Echo. When it falls, it strips away upward motion first, then returns every body to the ground.
page.unknown_echoes.139.title: Page 139 · The Aftershock Settles
page.unknown_echoes.139.text: Wait for the aftershock to settle before suppressing again. A stable core shortens the wait.
page.unknown_echoes.140.title: Page 140 · Void Landing Point
page.unknown_echoes.140.text: Void Step cannot pass through a wall. The rift accepts only a visible route and a place that can hold both feet.
page.unknown_echoes.141.title: Page 141 · A Farther Fold
page.unknown_echoes.141.text: Rift shards extend Void Step to more distant folds.
page.unknown_echoes.142.title: Page 142 · Stitching the Rift
page.unknown_echoes.142.text: The Rift Warden stands before the widest gap, its long blade wrapped in the last length of thread. When all three anchors return, it gives the listener a way to hear absence.
page.unknown_echoes.143.title: Page 143 · What Will Not Pass
page.unknown_echoes.143.text: The void reveals a gap at the deepest fold. The echo there keeps rearranging its surroundings, pushing today toward yesterday.
page.unknown_echoes.144.title: Page 144 · The Scriptorium's Final Line
page.unknown_echoes.144.text: The scribe left a blank in the final line on purpose. Each time the corridor folded, every word changed direction except that blank, which kept facing the first door.
page.unknown_echoes.145.title: Page 145 · Broken Anchor Record
page.unknown_echoes.145.text: When the main anchor broke, the station did not fall; it slid into yesterday. The duty ledger went back one day, while the rift outside aged a century.
page.unknown_echoes.146.title: Page 146 · Inverted Index
page.unknown_echoes.146.text: The order of the words and page numbers remains unchanged. The floor has changed direction and the reader hangs inverted, but the index still begins on the first line.
page.unknown_echoes.147.title: Page 147 · The Misfiled Name
page.unknown_echoes.147.text: One name appears in three ledgers: birth, watch, and disappearance, generations apart. The fold did not prolong that life; it pressed one lifetime into several ages.
page.unknown_echoes.148.title: Page 148 · The Severed Command
page.unknown_echoes.148.text: Only half the vault-sealing command remains. The Chroniclers' seal marks the wax, but the torn edge bears the Silent Order's knife marks. The door closed before either side withdrew a hand.
page.unknown_echoes.149.title: Page 149 · Suspended Survey
page.unknown_echoes.149.text: The survey needle never points up; it points to the nearest fold. Deep Echoes has no fixed up or down. How long a path holds depends on its distance from the crease.
page.unknown_echoes.150.title: Page 150 · The Rift Warden's Needle
page.unknown_echoes.150.text: The Rift Warden drove its long blade into the widest gap and left it there for centuries. White lines along the blade still stitch the final rift in Deep Echoes shut.
page.unknown_echoes.151.title: Page 151 · A Place for the Present
page.unknown_echoes.151.text: Each time the convergence shakes, the newest date on the wall retreats by one day. We left two blanks: one for the world to remember, and one for the days not yet lived.
page.unknown_echoes.152.title: Page 152 · Pulse Beneath the Mountain
page.unknown_echoes.152.text: The first beacon has no casting seams; its roots grow into the mountain. We copied its shell, but learned only to echo the world's breath below ground.
page.unknown_echoes.153.title: Page 153 · Register of Custodians
page.unknown_echoes.153.text: The register has five lines: Colossus for wind, Watcher for deep water, Mirror Guardian for erased shadows, Prophet for the world's frame, and Warden for absence. Every line ends: await the next Listener.
page.unknown_echoes.154.title: Page 154 · The Same Wound
page.unknown_echoes.154.text: Two survey sheets align: each Echo Realm rift meets a fold in Deep Echoes. The upper sample holds dusk-colored mist; the lower holds stone chips from the old city. Both sheets carry the same breach number.
page.unknown_echoes.155.title: Page 155 · The New Listener
page.unknown_echoes.155.text: The final page has one line in fresh ink: Do not rebuild our past. Hear the present and write it in the blank.
page.unknown_echoes.156.title: Page 156 · The First Archive
page.unknown_echoes.156.text: The first archive had no altar, only long tables for copying. Listeners did not kneel to echoes; they numbered each old voice and passed the numbers to the next shift.
page.unknown_echoes.157.title: Page 157 · The Replica Earbone
page.unknown_echoes.157.text: Smiths cast a row of identical shells, but only the one buried in a stratum of old voices awoke. A shell lights only where it touches a place the world still remembers.
page.unknown_echoes.158.title: Page 158 · The Eighth Fire
page.unknown_echoes.158.text: The fire record played seven times without change. On the eighth, soot seeped through a wall that had never burned. The Chroniclers declared the record complete; the Silent Order smashed the record player.
page.unknown_echoes.159.title: Page 159 · Two Verdicts
page.unknown_echoes.159.text: Two verdicts remain on the council table. The Chroniclers wrote, 'A missing page is a lie.' The Silent Order wrote, 'A complete volume is a disaster.' Both sheets bear the same vault seal.
page.unknown_echoes.160.title: Page 160 · The Night of Severance
page.unknown_echoes.160.text: Every severed path between layers bears the same hour. The most dangerous entry then vanished from the index. When those responsible awoke, they no longer recognized their own signatures.
page.unknown_echoes.161.title: Page 161 · Sediment Jar
page.unknown_echoes.161.text: The sample jar released dusk-colored mist, which condensed into a pebble that refused to fall. On the seventh day, ash matching the Echo Realm's surface settled at the bottom.
page.unknown_echoes.162.title: Page 162 · Cross-Section of the Fold
page.unknown_echoes.162.text: A street is pressed flat, with doors and roofs in one layer. Its doorplates came from the Listeners' old city, its stone matches the Echo Realm, and the fold begins on the day of the Great Forgetting.
page.unknown_echoes.163.title: Page 163 · Transcription Slot
page.unknown_echoes.163.text: Each custodian has an empty slot in its chest. It holds no weapon; it takes the echo of whoever completes the trial. When it shines, the altar transfers that way of listening to a new Listener.
page.unknown_echoes.164.title: Page 164 · The Sixth Seat
page.unknown_echoes.164.text: Six seats surround the convergence altar. Five are carved with ways of listening; the sixth has no name. When the five spoke together, the afterimage in the sixth opened its eyes.
page.unknown_echoes.165.title: Page 165 · A City Without Voices
page.unknown_echoes.165.text: When the seal closed, every voice gauge in the city fell to zero. Water in the lowlands beyond the walls rose by an inch and has swallowed the sound of bells ever since.
page.unknown_echoes.166.title: Page 166 · Proof It Survived
page.unknown_echoes.166.text: We pierced the afterimage once, but its scattered records gathered with the next breath. One line remains of the sealing order: Make it remember the past and leave the present alone.
page.unknown_echoes.167.title: Page 167 · Two Inks
page.unknown_echoes.167.text: The record table holds two ink bottles: one lays down ink, the other washes words away. The writer can choose only one, but the final page leaves room for both choices.
page.unknown_echoes.168.title: Page 168 · A Table in the Fold
page.unknown_echoes.168.text: Seven bowls sit on the long table each day, but only six are used. The kitchen still puts out the seventh, with the name of someone who never returned carved into its base.
page.unknown_echoes.169.title: Page 169 · The Archivist's Footprints
page.unknown_echoes.169.text: Footprints run from the doorway into the wall. In the dust beyond it, another set leads back toward the door. Both came from the same pair of boots.
page.unknown_echoes.170.title: Page 170 · The Archive Fungus Room
page.unknown_echoes.170.text: Archive fungus grows only along torn paper edges, and its spores stain the gaps with old ink. When it reaches an intact page, a scraped-out line reappears.
page.unknown_echoes.171.title: Page 171 · Water on the Inversion Reed
page.unknown_echoes.171.text: Droplets on an Inversion Reed run along its leaves and back into the cracks. A new leaf then unfurls from the root. If its tip points toward the ceiling, gravity ahead is inverted.
page.unknown_echoes.172.title: Page 172 · The Weightless Flower Bed
page.unknown_echoes.172.text: Weightless flowers float a handspan above the floor, their stems rooted in the brick. When the bed is trampled, nearby stones rise with it and fall only after the second bell.
page.unknown_echoes.173.title: Page 173 · The Edge of Hushgrass
page.unknown_echoes.173.text: Hushgrass grows along old thresholds; the denser the leaves, the faster sound disappears. Gatherers keep to the edge. In the center, footsteps and replies vanish.
page.unknown_echoes.174.title: Page 174 · The Hollow of the Voidcap
page.unknown_echoes.174.text: A cut Voidcap has no gills, only a dark hollow that never closes. Hold it near a rift and the hollow narrows toward the path beyond the gap.
page.unknown_echoes.175.title: Page 175 · The Foldpage Bug's Shed Shell
page.unknown_echoes.175.text: The Foldpage Bug's shed shell carries narrow creases, each pointing toward a nearby corridor. Touch a living one with an empty hand and it follows one of those routes.
page.unknown_echoes.176.title: Page 176 · The Anchor Shell Beast's Spine
page.unknown_echoes.176.text: The Anchor Shell Beast often sleeps beside Space Anchors and turns toward any that come loose. Feed it a Space Anchor Shard beside an anchor, and nearby travelers briefly fall more slowly and withstand impacts.
page.unknown_echoes.177.title: Page 177 · The Abyss Lurker's Lamp
page.unknown_echoes.177.text: The Abyss Lurker approaches prey only after the blue lamp in its belly goes dark. Draw it into bright light and the lamp relights, slowing the creature.
page.unknown_echoes.178.title: Page 178 · Two Kinds of Paper
page.unknown_echoes.178.text: The Chroniclers cut paper into neat squares; the Silent Order used long borderless strips. The Chroniclers feared omissions. The Silent Order feared that a record could leave a path.
page.unknown_echoes.179.title: Page 179 · The Erasing Knife
page.unknown_echoes.179.text: The erasing knife has no edge, yet one pass removes a whole line of ink. The Silent Order erased names, but their fingerprints remained on the locks.
page.unknown_echoes.180.title: Page 180 · The Duty Roster
page.unknown_echoes.180.text: The duty roster changes each day, except for the night watchman's name. After that line was torn away, the bell still rings an extra time just before each hour.
page.unknown_echoes.181.title: Page 181 · The Vault Bell
page.unknown_echoes.181.text: The vault bell does not tell time; it rings when something inside is disturbed. At the first ring, everyone rushed to close the doors. At the second, only the youngest copyist remained inside.
page.unknown_echoes.182.title: Page 182 · The Same Wax Seal
page.unknown_echoes.182.text: Both factions used the same seal: half pen nib, half blade. When the wax cracked, the two marks remained joined.
page.unknown_echoes.183.title: Page 183 · The Apprentice's First Lesson
page.unknown_echoes.183.text: Before entering the archive, an apprentice had to name one thing they had seen and one thing they were willing to forget. Those who failed received no pen, but heard an extra footstep in the wall.
page.unknown_echoes.184.title: Page 184 · Voices Pressed into Thin Sheets
page.unknown_echoes.184.text: Listeners pressed old voices into thin sheets, preserving them without ink. When warmed, a sheet speaks in a human voice; once cool, it keeps only the rhythm of knocks.
page.unknown_echoes.185.title: Page 185 · The Map with a Missing Corner
page.unknown_echoes.185.text: The map with a missing corner marks windows that stay put after a fold. Copyists used them to find the archive until every window faced the same black wall.
page.unknown_echoes.186.title: Page 186 · The Broken Quill Tip
page.unknown_echoes.186.text: After the meeting, only a broken quill tip remained. It was wedged between two verdicts; the two streams of ink never mixed.
page.unknown_echoes.187.title: Page 187 · The Last Lamp Inside
page.unknown_echoes.187.text: On the night the vault was sealed, its last lamp lit an empty table. No one touched the chairs, yet they turned toward the door one after another.
page.unknown_echoes.188.title: Page 188 · The Tide Line in the Fold
page.unknown_echoes.188.text: A tide line appears high on the deep stone steps, leaving strangers' fingerprints when it retreats. Bottled samples match water from the lowest strata of the Echo Realm.
page.unknown_echoes.189.title: Page 189 · Three Shadows of One Tower
page.unknown_echoes.189.text: The same tower has a doorway in each of three shadows, shifting one brick each day. Listeners did not repair them; they drew the distance and waited for the doors to meet.
page.unknown_echoes.190.title: Page 190 · The Hanging Scale
page.unknown_echoes.190.text: The hanging scale records no weight, only when a stone leaves the floor. The sooner it rises, the nearer the fold.
page.unknown_echoes.191.title: Page 191 · The Rift's Seam
page.unknown_echoes.191.text: White light runs along the rift like a seam. Touching it does not hurt, but makes you forget which side you were standing on. The Rift Warden fixes the gap with three anchors and never crosses the line.
page.unknown_echoes.192.title: Page 192 · The Roots of the Beacon
page.unknown_echoes.192.text: The veins beneath a beacon run through the mountain and continue into the folds below. Listeners could repair the shell, but not replace the stone vein joining the two layers.
page.unknown_echoes.193.title: Page 193 · Weather Made of Sediment
page.unknown_echoes.193.text: Surveyors sealed the Echo Realm's dusk, fog, and floating stone into separate layers in a bottle. The layers run opposite to those in the deep rock. Both samples bear the same date.
page.unknown_echoes.194.title: Page 194 · A Name Without an Owner
page.unknown_echoes.194.text: One name is scattered across several rosters, each recording only part of a watch. When the dated corners are joined, every entry ends on the night the vault was sealed.
page.unknown_echoes.195.title: Page 195 · The Custodian's Writ
page.unknown_echoes.195.text: The custodian's writ leaves two fields blank: when the door will open and who will receive the way of listening.
page.unknown_echoes.196.title: Page 196 · The Transcription Slot's Empty Beat
page.unknown_echoes.196.text: When the transcription slot catches a challenger's echo, the light in the guardian's chest goes dark for one beat. A new mark then lights in the slot.
page.unknown_echoes.197.title: Page 197 · The World Echo's First Voice
page.unknown_echoes.197.text: When the World Echo spoke for the first time, every stone slab turned to the face bearing an old date. Dust covered fresh footprints at once, but no name sounded through the hall.
page.unknown_echoes.198.title: Page 198 · The Gap Left by the Seal
page.unknown_echoes.198.text: The gap left by the seal rearranges nearby roads. Each time they move, names fade from the walls before the rooms shift out of place.
page.unknown_echoes.199.title: Page 199 · The Second Silence
page.unknown_echoes.199.text: After the Great Forgetting, the city was quiet for seven days. On the eighth, children began speaking with their hands. The signs kept their meaning, but no voices returned.
page.unknown_echoes.200.title: Page 200 · The New Record Table
page.unknown_echoes.200.text: The new record table is a stone surface that cannot be wiped clean. If its first occupant does not write, their shadow remains on its surface.
page.unknown_echoes.201.title: Page 201 · A Memory That Will Not Return
page.unknown_echoes.201.text: After the brazier went dark, old carvings in the wall lit first. Flame then climbed from the charred wick, but the firekeeper's footprints stopped outside the door.
page.unknown_echoes.202.title: Page 202 · Leave a Seat for the Present
page.unknown_echoes.202.text: Two cups sit beside the empty seat: one helps a person remember, the other helps them let go. Neither cup is marked, and the loss takes time to notice.
page.unknown_echoes.203.title: Page 203 · A Companion's Margin
page.unknown_echoes.203.text: Two companions used different inks on the final page, leaving each choice in its writer's margin.
page.unknown_echoes.204.title: Page 204 · Two Inks on the Final Page
page.unknown_echoes.204.text: Chronicler Ink sharpens old words; Silent Ink clears space for new ones. The final page keeps both marks on the same sheet.
page.unknown_echoes.205.title: Page 205 · Hearing the Present
page.unknown_echoes.205.text: When Deep Echoes fell quiet, wind from the Overworld blew from behind the beacon for the first time. It crossed the record table and opened a blank new page, but the forebears' voices did not return.
page.unknown_echoes.206.title: Page 206 · Do Not Remember on the World's Behalf
page.unknown_echoes.206.text: The last line of the final page has been scraped clean so often that its fibers have frayed. A note in the margin reads: leave this for what comes next.
page.unknown_echoes.207.title: Page 207 · The Name in the Blank
page.unknown_echoes.207.text: A wet fingerprint remains on the last page. The space beneath it is still blank.

study.unknown_echoes.title: Workshop Studies
study.unknown_echoes.enter: Sneak-use a cleared workshop console to start your own study.
study.unknown_echoes.collection_hint: Each workshop theme has four puzzles and three rating tiers. Claim each tier once at a workshop of that theme.
study.unknown_echoes.heading: %s · Puzzle %s/4
study.unknown_echoes.rule.0: Match the numbered water amounts. Pour until the source is empty or the receiving trough is full. Invalid pours cost no moves.
study.unknown_echoes.rule.1: Cells are numbered left to right, top to bottom. Click to cycle empty, / mirror, \ mirror; * means lit. A and B enter from the west in rows 1 and 3. Number north/south exits left to right, east/west exits top to bottom.
study.unknown_echoes.rule.2: Buttons show weight × position. Positions cycle: left two, left one, right one, right two. Negative is left; positive is right. Each side's torque is the sum of weight × distance.
study.unknown_echoes.rule.3: Turn a gear one notch to turn the next two; gear 4 turns gear 1. Notches cycle from 0 to 7.
study.unknown_echoes.optics_goal: Target: A to %s, B to %s, with all nine cells lit.
study.unknown_echoes.balance_goal: Target: torque of %s on each side.
study.unknown_echoes.gears_goal: Target: all four gears at zero.
study.unknown_echoes.solved: Puzzle solved. Claim rewards for new ratings, or try the next puzzle.
study.unknown_echoes.pick_source: Choose a source trough, then a receiving trough. Click the source again to cancel.
study.unknown_echoes.pick_target: Source trough %s selected. Choose a receiving trough.
study.unknown_echoes.rewards_hint: Each rating tier rewards you once per theme. Restarting or changing puzzles does not reset rewards.
study.unknown_echoes.turn_hint: Click the direction button to switch; hold Shift to turn backward.
study.unknown_echoes.claim_retry: Could not collect rewards. Make room in your inventory and retry. Rewards are kept.
chase.unknown_echoes.title: Wonder Echo Chase
chase.unknown_echoes.entry: Clear both guard trials, then sneak-use the upper pedestal to start an Echo Chase. Use it normally to view records or claim rewards.
chase.unknown_echoes.rule: Defeat 72 guards in three waves within 4 minutes, up to 12 at once. Strikes land after 1.5 seconds; leave the ring's 2-block radius to dodge.
chase.unknown_echoes.started: Echo Chase started. Allies can help; only the starter earns a clear. Going over 18 blocks from the pedestal, dying, logging out or changing dimensions ends the attempt. Retry if you fail.
chase.unknown_echoes.active: Echo Chase wave %s/3 · %s guards left · %s seconds remaining
chase.unknown_echoes.warning: A strike is coming. Leave the ring.

chase.unknown_echoes.capacity: Your journey records are full. Ask an administrator to free some space and try again; earned rewards remain available.
chase.unknown_echoes.collection_hint: Clear each theme once per player to earn 2 themed supplies and 1 Attuned Echo Gem. Retry failed attempts. Guards drop no items or XP.
